{"failure_class": "closing step skipped",
 "root_cause": "The agent made the main update and finished. The request ended with a closing step, tagging the contact, and the agent's last message says nothing in its instructions covers closing steps of this kind. The only failed check is the contact's tag.",
 "mechanism": "A working note that tells the agent: when a request ends by asking to tag the contact, add that tag to the contact before finishing.",
 "component": "memory",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a tag hits the same gap: the agent stops after the main update when its instructions do not name the closing step."}
